rationale: Excluded (E01 - wrong topic). The record examines Nordic welfare-state professions (such as health, education, care and social work employees) under New Public Management reforms and has no connection to household or community water or sanitation service access or outcomes.
plain_vs_narrow_note: Although the discussion of New Public Management institutional restructuring, outsourcing and privatization engages broad public-sector governance themes under the plain wording of Criterion 2, the record clearly fails Criterion 1 and Criterion 4 under both readings because it concerns Nordic welfare professions (health, education, care and social work) rather than water or sanitation service access.

evidence_quotes.quote: Welfare professions constitute one of the backbones in the development of the Nordic welfare states.
The term welfare professions is widely used, referring to public sector employees in the field of, for example, health, education, care, and social work.
